paper_title: Measuring (a Sufficient) World Model in LLMs A Variance Decomposition   Framework
caption: : Meaningful Variability Share
model_annotation: The image displays a series of stacked bar charts across four domains: Health and Nutrition, Logistics, Personal Finance, and Travel and Transportation. Each domain contains two stacked bars, one labeled "70B llama" and the other "8B llama", representing different model sizes. The vertical axis is scaled from 0.0 to 1.0, indicating the Meaningful Variability Share (MVS), as noted in the caption. Each bar is divided into two segments: a green lower segment labeled "MVS" and a blue upper segment labeled "1-MVS" in the legend, representing the proportion of meaningful variability and its complement, respectively. In all charts, the green segment (MVS) occupies approximately the lower half of each bar (around 0.5), while the blue segment (1-MVS) occupies the upper half, suggesting that the meaningful variability share is consistently around 50% across all model sizes and domains. The bars are arranged horizontally with categories (model sizes) on the x-axis and the MVS value on the y-axis. There is no visible sorting or emphasis on any particular bar, and all bars appear uniform in height, indicating no significant variation in MVS across the different models or domains.
